Based on the retrieved standards documentation, ISO 45001 clause 9.3 specifies the following safety-specific inputs that top management must consider in the OH&S management review:

## Core Safety Performance Inputs (Clause 9.3)

- **OH&S performance trends** — including incidents and nonconformities
- **Audit results** — from internal and external OH&S audits
- **Monitoring results** — ongoing surveillance of OH&S performance
- **Compliance evaluations** — assessments of legal and other requirement fulfillment

## System and Contextual Inputs (Clause 9.3)

- **Status of prior actions** — follow-through on previous management review decisions
- **Changes in context and requirements** — internal and external factors affecting the OH&S system
- **Risks and opportunities** — those identified per clauses 6.1.1 and 6.1.2.2
- **Resource adequacy** — whether sufficient resources are available for OH&S management

## Stakeholder and Cultural Inputs (Clause 9.3)

- **Worker consultation and participation** — feedback from workers and their representatives
- **Communications with interested parties** — external stakeholder input

## Improvement-Oriented Inputs (Clause 9.3)

- **Policy and objective achievement** — progress toward stated OH&S goals
- **Improvement opportunities** — areas where the system can be enhanced

These inputs align with top management's leadership responsibilities under **clause 5.1**, which includes accountability for preventing work-related injury and ill health, and ensuring OH&S policy and objectives fit organizational strategy.
